/**
 * PROBE — a compliant surface full of near-miss shapes. It names spheres and
 * lines, keeps a label map keyed by domain, carries ONE coincidental
 * `health: "health"` pair (an i18n section key — the shape
 * lib/wallet/coverage-sections.ts has), reads the taxonomy's `scoreCategory`,
 * quotes the old table in comments — and takes every line→area answer from
 * `areaForLob`. The guard must NOT flag it.
 */
import { areaForLob } from "@/lib/protection/domains"
import type { EventDomain } from "@/lib/services/life-events/types"

// const PRIORITY_LOBS = { mobility: ["motor"], residence: ["home"] }
/* const LOB_DOMAIN = { motor: "mobility", home: "residence", life: "household" } */

export const SPHERE_LABELS: Record<EventDomain, { en: string }> = {
    household: { en: "Family" },
    residence: { en: "Home" },
    property: { en: "Property" },
    mobility: { en: "Vehicles" },
    work: { en: "Work" },
    money: { en: "Money" },
    health: { en: "Health" },
    lifestyle: { en: "Lifestyle" },
}

export const SECTION_KEY = {
    health: "health",
    motorAndVehicles: "motor",
    homeAndProperty: "home",
} as const

const branch = { id: "motor", scoreCategory: "property", writeEnabled: true }

export function sphereOf(lob: string): EventDomain | undefined {
    return areaForLob(lob)?.domain
}

export function isMobility(lob: string): boolean {
    return areaForLob(lob)?.id === "mobility" || branch.id === lob
}
